audience: security teams that track vulnerability scans of their external targets in Intruder

useCases.title: Review open issues by severity
useCases.text: List the current security issues, filtered by severity, target or tag. List the targets affected by one issue.

useCases.title: Trace an issue to the hosts it affects
useCases.text: List the occurrences of one issue. Each occurrence is one affected target, port or path. Read the scanner output that proves one occurrence.

useCases.title: Report progress on fixed occurrences
useCases.text: List the fixed occurrences with their remediation dates, to report progress.

useCases.title: Check exposed services and plan capacity
useCases.text: List the network services found on external targets, by address, port and protocol. List the licences to check plan capacity.

useCases.title: Add a target and start a scan
useCases.text: Add a domain, hostname or IP address to scope. Start a scan on chosen targets or tags, then check its status. Adding a target does not start a scan.

useCases.title: Add a triage note to an occurrence
useCases.text: Add a plain-text comment to one occurrence of an issue, such as a triage note. Read the comments already on that occurrence.
